about.title: About Us
about.body: Pet Vet Clinic is a full-service veterinary practice for companion animals, offering surgeries, examinations, ultrasound, lab tests, and grooming — plus a complete range of veterinary supplies, medications, and pet food. We proudly serve pet families from two convenient branches in Nasr City and Zaitoon, Cairo.
